position_semantics: position is footprint center at bottom/support Y; collider_size is [X width,Y height,Z depth]; collider center must add half height to position Y
instance_transform_contract: No per-instance arbitrary rotation or scale. Asset template owns physical dimensions and canonical projection. Render bounds may differ from physical collider and must be reported separately.

decisions: Right-wall shelf and rear-left fridge replace previous conflicting facings; changed positions have a source/view/layout cause, not decorative nudging.
Island moves to x1.8,z-2.1 and body height.65; two separate apple trays sit at y.65 and reach y.9.
20 actual instances: 8 fixture bodies, 3 supported countertop/display objects, 2 plants, 2 bulk containers, 5 crates. Existing painted shelf contents count zero additional instances.
Additional floor objects stay at left peripheral wall or stock back corner, preserving central entry and sales circulation. Repeated crates are physical stacks with exact support heights.
Utility and cleaning preserve the separate interior proposal positions and sizes; this calculation does not certify their eventual source-image view direction.
limitations: Static footprint and support planning only; Unity Player movement, actual Collider shape, rendered silhouette and lighting remain untested here.
A source image must be mapped to its declared physical template; per-instance arbitrary scale/rotation is forbidden.
